description: This source file provides utility methods for testing with ZooKeeper, including ensuring ZooKeeper is running and accessible, using the ZooKeeper client library. It defines a static utility class with methods for synchronous and asynchronous checks, as well as a nested watcher class.

classes.name: ZookeeperTestUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to verify ZooKeeper's availability and connectivity during tests.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A nested class implementing the Watcher interface, used internally to handle ZooKeeper watch events.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeper
methods.description: Synchronous method to ensure ZooKeeper is running; throws if not.

methods.name: EnsureZooKeeperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that checks whether ZooKeeper is accessible and running.
